decisions.reason: As a flagship multi-model electric line aligned with the firm's electrification direction, it still has high option value and there is no clear evidence yet that would justify abandoning it.

Because this industrial electric hall-heater range stays close to core customers and applications, the firm would usually continue it while demand uncertainty can be resolved at manageable incremental cost.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series remains a strategically important decarbonization option with learning value from real operation, so despite market uncertainty the firm is more likely to preserve than drop it.
